content:
Jasmine Liu: Hey folks — renewal escalation. Acct: Northbridge (renewal due end of March). Their security team is asking for (1) updated SOC 2 report + bridge letter (if applicable) and (2) written statement on our data retention + deletion behavior. Do we have the new one-pager pack v2 ready to share? And what’s the right way to share SOC 2 under NDA now?

Rachel Kim: +1, I’m on the thread w/ their SecOps lead. They specifically asked for “SOC 2 Type II report and retention policy statement”. They previously had an old PDF from last year and are calling out inconsistencies.

Naomi Feldman: Yep — pack is ready. Customer-facing PDFs:
- Security FAQ v2 (PDF)
- Compliance/Security One-Pagers Pack v2 (PDF) incl. retention + residency + audit logging

Naomi Feldman: For SOC 2: report itself is still NDA-gated + must go through GRC (Olga/Daniel). We can send the one-pagers immediately (no NDA needed) since they’re written for prospects/customers.

Security Review Bot: Reminder: Do not share SOC 2 report, pen test reports, or bridge letters outside approved process. See: “Customer Security Review Process” (restricted).

Jasmine Liu: Got it. Can someone drop the link to the one-pager pack v2? I want to reply today.

Naomi Feldman: Here’s the “field share” folder (internal link): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/RI-Security-Enablement-Kit-v2 (CS has access). Latest PDFs are:
- `Security_FAQ_v2.pdf`
- `Compliance_OnePagers_Pack_v2.pdf`

Naomi Feldman: Canonical (for quoting / screenshots): https://confluence.redwood.inference/display/SE/Enterprise+Security+FAQ+v2

Rachel Kim: Perfect. For the retention statement, do we have a specific one-pager page I can point them to so they stop asking for custom language?

Naomi Feldman: Yep, in the pack it’s the “Data Retention Controls” one-pager. Also the Confluence page: https://confluence.redwood.inference/display/SEC/Data+Retention+Controls+One-Pager

Naomi Feldman: Please avoid adding any “always/never” language in email. The one-pager is already vetted.

Jasmine Liu: Awesome. SOC 2 flow — they have an NDA in place already from initial procurement last year, but I’m not 100% sure it’s still current. Who should I route to?

Olga Petrov: Loop me + Daniel. We’ll confirm NDA status and handle report distribution.

Olga Petrov: Process (high level):
1) Confirm there’s a current NDA covering “confidential audit reports” (or execute Redwood NDA).
2) Once confirmed, GRC shares SOC 2 report via approved channel and logs recipient + date.
3) If they want a bridge letter / scope statement, we’ll provide what’s available/approved.

Olga Petrov: Don’t attach SOC 2 directly from your email, even if “they already had it” — we need a clean audit trail of what was sent + when.

Daniel Carter: +1. Jasmine/Rachel — if you forward me the customer’s request + email domain + who the recipient is, I can turn it around quickly. Typical SLA is 1–2 business days, but for renewals we can try same-day depending on NDA verification.

Liam O'Rourke: FYI on retention: customers sometimes interpret “logs” as “prompt content”. The retention one-pager is explicit on what’s retained by default and what’s configurable; use that instead of paraphrasing. If they push on “prompt retention,” we should confirm which deployment mode they’re on (Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private).

Rachel Kim: They’re Hosted today but considering Dedicated for the renewal term. Their question was mostly “How long do you keep application data / prompts / outputs, and can we request deletion.”

Naomi Feldman: Then definitely send the retention one-pager + Security FAQ v2. Both have Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private callouts. If they’re moving to Dedicated, the shared responsibility boundary is important.

Jasmine Liu: OK action plan:
- I’ll send One-Pagers Pack v2 + Security FAQ v2 today (no NDA).
- I’ll CC Olga/Daniel on SOC 2 report request and let customer know it’s shared under NDA via our compliance team.

Jasmine Liu: Olga/Daniel — what’s the best wording for my email so I don’t overcommit on timing?

Olga Petrov: Suggested snippet:
“Happy to provide our SOC 2 Type II report. Per policy, we share the report under NDA via our Compliance team. If you can confirm the intended recipients and that an NDA is in place (or request an NDA), we’ll coordinate secure delivery and follow up with next steps.”

Daniel Carter: If you want something shorter:
“Looping in Compliance (Olga/Daniel) to coordinate SOC 2 report access under NDA. In the meantime, attached are our updated security one-pagers including data retention and deletion controls.”

Rachel Kim: Great. Also: where do we record that we sent the one-pagers pack? HubSpot note vs ticket?

Naomi Feldman: HubSpot note is fine for customer-facing docs. For SOC 2 distribution, Daniel will log it on the GRC side. If you add a HubSpot note like “SOC2 report requested; routed to GRC on DATE” that helps.

Jasmine Liu: Thanks all. Sending now.

Rachel Kim: :thumbsup: keep me posted if they come back with additional questionnaire items.

Olga Petrov: :white_check_mark: when you email, please include who the recipients are (names + emails). That’s the #1 thing that blocks us.

Daniel Carter: Yep, and if they’re asking for subprocessor list / DPA at the same time, mention it — we can bundle responses.

Jasmine Liu: Will do. Closing the loop after I hear back from them.
